name: Humayun's Tomb, Delhi
description: Humayun's Tomb in Delhi, India, is a grand red sandstone mausoleum raised in the 1560s for the Mughal emperor Humayun. His widow, Empress Bega Begum, commissioned it, and Persian architects designed it. It sits in the middle of a formal four-part Persian garden, the first of its kind in India, and its design paved the way for the Taj Mahal.
